bottleneck.description: Future NdPr producer at Nolans (NT) with multi-sovereign ECA financing and binding offtakes to Hyundai/Kia/Siemens Gamesa/Traxys; first production mid-2029.

dependency.key_customers: Hyundai, Kia, Siemens Gamesa, Traxys (500tpa NdPr + 7.5tpa DyTb)
dependency.key_suppliers: Internal Nolans deposit (pre-production); Australian engineering contractors

editorial.notes: Nolans achieved FID with A$1.6B fully funded (Hancock at 17.5%, multi-sovereign ECA syndicate, NAIF, Strategic Reserve eligibility) and ~93% offtake target contracted. Strategically important as one of very few Western NdPr projects, but it is pre-production until 2029, so it does not yet exert a bottleneck. MEDIUM reflects the strategic position once online combined with execution and dilution risk. Not flagging going-concern: capital is now in place per recent A$350M placement and Hancock underwrite, though equity holders face material dilution.
